[[X'Ting]] [[Trillot]] was a member of a '''brood''', [[Reproduction/Legends|child]] of a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] yet impoverished [[Trillot's brood-mother|female]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Trillot was the distant elder sibling of [[Fizzik]], and employed the younger sibling in [[Gender/Legends|their]] branch of the criminal [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] based in a hidden [[Trillot's facility|facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].<ref name="TCD" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> whilst Trillot was in the midst of his species' three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] transition to female, the siblings were caught between the machinations of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the two [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] superpowers.<ref name="TCD" />
